mapper.select: SELECT keywords FROM kb_search_record WHERE del_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND keywords IS NOT NULL AND keywords != '' GROUP BY keywords ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT keywords, COUNT(*) as searchCount, AVG(result_count) as avgResultCount FROM kb_search_record WHERE del_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND keywords IS NOT NULL AND keywords != '' GROUP BY keywords ORDER BY searchCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(create_time) as searchDate, COUNT(*) as searchCount FROM kb_search_record WHERE del_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY searchDate DESC
